title: Heartbeat-checkpoint integration with parallel executor
description:
## Goal

Integrate heartbeat and per-SNR-boundary checkpointing with the
parallel executor so SIGINT mid-run yields a flushed checkpoint
and `--resume` produces byte-identical deterministic columns.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation for gf2-sim
pipeline) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] SIGINT mid-run flushes a checkpoint compatible with
  the design-doc schema; `--resume` from that checkpoint produces
  byte-identical `fer` / `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` vs
  an uninterrupted reference run at the same seed.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
